# HyperTune Garage - Automotive Detailing, PPF, Tuning & Maintenance

> HyperTune Garage is Pakistan's premier specialized automotive workshop, computerized diagnostics studio, Paint Protection Film (PPF) application center, and European/Japanese luxury car care facility located in Islamabad (with Rawalpindi coverage via insured valet pickup while our Rawalpindi hub is under development).

## Specialized Automotive Services

- [Paint Protection Film (PPF)](https://hypertunegarage.pk/services/paint-protection-film-ppf/): Self-healing, anti-yellowing optical TPU paint protection film with computerized blade-free CAD plotter cut precision.
- [Car Detailing & 9H Ceramic Coating](https://hypertunegarage.pk/services/car-detailing/): Multi-stage paint correction, hydrophobic 9H ceramic coating, interior deep cleaning, and steam sanitization.
- [Engine Repair & Overhaul](https://hypertunegarage.pk/services/engine-services/): Precision engine rebuilding, cylinder head resurfacing, timing belt/chain replacement, and turbocharger servicing.
- [Car Diagnostics & Pre-Purchase Inspection](https://hypertunegarage.pk/services/inspection-diagnostics/): Dealer-level OEM diagnostic systems (BMW ISTA, Mercedes Xentry, VAG ODIS, Toyota Techstream) and digital pre-purchase inspections.
- [Periodic Maintenance & Lube Service](https://hypertunegarage.pk/services/maintenance-servicing/): Factory-scheduled synthetic oil changes, genuine filter renewals, fluid checks, and multi-point health inspections.
- [Brakes, Suspension & 3D Alignment](https://hypertunegarage.pk/services/brake-suspension-steering/): Brake servicing, AIRMATIC/hydraulic suspension overhaul, steering rack repair, and computerized 3D laser wheel alignment.
- [Transmission & Gearbox Services](https://hypertunegarage.pk/services/transmission-drivetrain/): Dual-clutch (DSG/DCT), CVT, and automatic torque-converter gearbox diagnostics, mechatronic repair, and fluid servicing.
- [Vehicle Wrap & Color Change](https://hypertunegarage.pk/services/vehicle-wrap/): Cast vinyl color-change wraps, stealth satin/gloss finishes, roof wraps, and chrome-delete styling.
- [Denting, Painting & Body Repair](https://hypertunegarage.pk/services/body-repair-paint/): Computerized spectrophotometer color matching, downdraft paint booth finishing, PDR, and chassis alignment.
- [Body Modification & Custom Body Kits](https://hypertunegarage.pk/services/body-modification/): OEM and aftermarket body kit installation, splitters, diffusers, spoilers, and custom fabrication.
- [Car AC Repair & Auto Electrical](https://hypertunegarage.pk/services/car-ac-repair/): Climate control servicing, R134a/R1234yf refrigerant recharge, cooling coil leak detection, and master auto-electrical wiring diagnostics.
- [Cooling, Fuel & Exhaust Systems](https://hypertunegarage.pk/services/cooling-fuel-exhaust/): Radiator flushing and OAT coolant service, ultrasonic fuel injector cleaning, catalytic converter care, and exhaust repair.

- [PPF vs Ceramic Coating in Pakistan](https://hypertunegarage.pk/blog/ceramic-coating-vs-ppf-pakistan-guide/): In-depth comparison of TPU Paint Protection Film vs 9H ceramic coating for Pakistani driving conditions.
- [Ceramic Coating Maintenance Guide](https://hypertunegarage.pk/blog/ceramic-coating-maintenance-guide-pakistan/): Proper wash techniques, multi-stage paint correction levels, and water-spot prevention.
- [P0A80 Hybrid Battery Repair Guide](https://hypertunegarage.pk/blog/p0a80-hybrid-battery-repair-guide-pakistan/): Causes, diagnostic steps, and module balancing vs replacement for Toyota and Honda hybrids.
- [BMW Drivetrain Malfunction & Check Engine Guide](https://hypertunegarage.pk/blog/bmw-check-engine-light-drivetrain-malfunction-guide/): ISTA fault diagnostics and common drivetrain repairs for BMW vehicles in Pakistan.
- [Engine Overhaul vs Replacement Guide](https://hypertunegarage.pk/blog/engine-overhaul-vs-engine-replacement-pakistan-guide/): Cost, reliability, and engineering comparison of rebuilding vs swapping an engine.
- [Car AC Cooling Troubleshooting in Summer](https://hypertunegarage.pk/blog/car-ac-cooling-troubleshooting-pakistan-summer/): Diagnosing weak AC airflow, compressor clutch faults, condenser heat soak, and refrigerant leaks.
- [Pre-Purchase Car Inspection Checklist](https://hypertunegarage.pk/blog/pre-purchase-car-inspection-checklist-pakistan/): Step-by-step mechanical, OBD, and paint-thickness inspection before buying a car.
- [Porsche Maintenance & Servicing Guide](https://hypertunegarage.pk/blog/porsche-maintenance-servicing-guide-pakistan/): Servicing intervals, PIWIS diagnostics, and PDK/PASM maintenance in Pakistan.
